metadata.intro: The Standard Model provides the definitive mathematical description of the fundamental particles and gauge interactions that constitute the physical universe. By unifying the electromagnetic, weak, and strong forces under the local gauge group SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1), the theory reveals the subatomic vacuum as a manifold of self-interacting fields. This roadmap navigates from the geometric foundation of the gauge principle to the mechanism of spontaneous symmetry breaking and the deep origins of matter-antimatter asymmetry.

bridges.theoretical-physics: The Standard Model utilizes the variational engine of the Lagrangian density and Noether's theorem to derive the conserved currents and gauge charges of the subatomic vacuum.
bridges.quantum-physics: The theory is formulated as a relativistic quantum field theory, where particles are recognized as localized excitations of field modes within a Fock space manifold.
bridges.astrophysics: The conditions of the early universe provide the primary laboratory for testing the Standard Model's predictions regarding baryogenesis and the thermal history of cosmic evolution.
bridges.mathematical-methods: The non-Abelian Lie groups and fiber bundle geometry of gauge theories provide the formal language for describing the internal symmetries of the particle manifold.

pillars.title: 1. The Gauge Principle & Field Formalism
pillars.narrative: Developing the geometric requirement of local phase invariance and the Yang-Mills construction that governs non-Abelian interactions.

pillars.title: 2. The Electroweak Interaction
pillars.narrative: Exploring the unification of electromagnetism and the weak force, characterizing the parity-violating V-A structure and flavor dynamics.

pillars.title: 3. The Higgs Mechanism & Symmetry Breaking
pillars.narrative: Characterizing the transition from symmetric massless radiation to the massive particle manifold through the spontaneous breaking of gauge invariance.

pillars.title: 4. Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD)
pillars.narrative: Navigating the SU(3) color sector, where self-interacting gluons lead to the phenomena of asymptotic freedom and infrared confinement.

pillars.title: 5. Baryogenesis & Frontier Constraints
pillars.narrative: Investigating the Sakharov conditions and the violations of CP and Baryon number required to generate the matter-dominated universe.
